name: Squat (Paused)
instructions: Unrack a barbell and descend into a full squat.
Pause for 2-3 seconds at the bottom — no bouncing, stay tight.
Drive explosively out of the hole.
The pause builds starting strength and positional awareness.
longevityNotes: Keep the squat pattern for life: depth and control matter more than load. Train it pain-free, leave reps in reserve, and your knees and hips will thank you at 80.
overview: An intermediate barbell squat-pattern exercise for the quadriceps. Squat (Paused) develops leg strength through a full range of motion, which carries straight into daily life.
